## Infra intervention 2026-11-25T15:05Z (recorded verbatim — coordinator): NIC-death restart → window r3

At ~14:01Z the guest's ens4 NIC lost its DHCP lease (`systemd-networkd:
ens4: Could not set DHCPv4 address: Connection timed out` → `ens4: Failed`
at 14:09Z — serial console). IAP SSH went unreachable; the guest stayed
RUNNING but serial went silent — model calls egress upstream so every
in-flight drive was wedging on dead network (the DF-R7.3-3 fence would
have reaped each at its deadline — honest rc:-15s, but a matrix of fenced
zeros is worthless for confirmation and ~50 lane-hours of budget).

start` (14:54Z) — fresh NIC, new external IP. Driver had settled 201
before the outage (last in-flight slots died un-recorded at the stop —
no result files, re-admitted on resume honestly).
